notes: ACCESS: reached exclusively through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in a dedicated tab; the category tree and every count came from same-origin fetch() run from a loaded https://www.fonq.nl page (no external HTTP client). PERMISSION: robots.txt has only a generic 'User-agent: *' with Crawl-delay 3 plus facet-parameter Disallow lines, no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot rule; it points to /llms.txt, which carries an explicit 'User-Agent: Anthropic / Allow: /'. Pacing kept at ~2-3 s per request. TREE: fonQ is a large Dutch general lifestyle marketplace (Etrias platform). URL shape is flat: /collections/. The furniture department is /collections/meubels (14373 artikelen). Its mega-menu gives the groups Kasten, Banken, Tafels, Bedden and Stoelen; Tuinmeubelen (2395) sits under Tuin & balkon, Kindermeubels under Kinderkamer and Badkamermeubels under Badkamer. Because the URLs are flat, I derived the real parent/child relationships from each page's own 'Type Product' facet, whose option counts are exhaustive: Kasten's 15 type options sum to exactly 1437 = its header, and Tuinmeubelen's 14 options sum to exactly 2395 = its header. I also harvested each page's in-content category links (nav/header/footer stripped) to find deeper nodes. COUNTS: every qty is the site's own rendered listing header, baked into the server-rendered HTML as N artikelen. INDEPENDENT CHECK: each listing also embeds a Merk (brand) facet whose options are single-valued and exhaustive; its option-count sum matched the header EXACTLY on 64 of the 65 leaves. The one exception is Dining Chairs (header 2436, brand sum 2440) and it is flagged. Drift check: hoekbank and tuinset re-read identically ~20 min later, eetkamerstoel moved 2436 -> 2435 (flagged). The h1 was verified to match the requested slug on all 65 leaves, so no silent parent-serving occurred. HIERARCHY DECISIONS: /collections/bankje (560) is a true parent - its type facet is exactly Eetkamerbank 62 + Hocker 128 + Loungebank 63 + Poef 249 + Voetenbank 58 - so it is emitted as the grouping row 'Benches, Ottomans & Poufs' over the three children that have their own URLs (Loungebank and Voetenbank have no collection page). Likewise /collections/tuinset (454) = Loungeset 377 + Tuinset 77, so 'Garden Sets' is a grouping row over Lounge Sets; the 77 remaining garden sets have no URL of their own. /collections/kapstokken (422) is a parent whose children are Staande kapstok (47, freestanding = furniture), Wandkapstok, Kapstokhaak, Deurkapstok and Kledinghanger - only the standing racks are furniture, the wall racks, hooks and hangers were dropped. /collections/barkruk (1149) already contains the Barstoel type (301), which has no separate page. The Bedden and Banken children are size/seat-count splits that fonQ itself publishes as nav categories, so they are kept as leaves; the generic residue types (Bed 404 vs 339 in the three bed leaves, Stoel 1164, Tafel 527, Bank 2139) have no dedicated URL. EXCLUDED AS EMPTY (page exists, 0 products, confirmed): Boxspring, Draaistoel (swivel chairs), Tuinkast. EXCLUDED AS SEO FILTER PAGES: every child link discovered on the leaves turned out to be a colour/material/shape landing page (houten-, witte-, zwarte-, velvet-, leren-, ronde-, ovale-, marmeren- prefixes, zit-sta-bureau, verstelbare-barkruk, bureau-met-opbergruimte and so on) - none were recorded. EXCLUDED AS NON-FURNITURE: Matrassen (mattresses), Lattenbodem (slatted bases), Bedonderdelen (bed parts), Beddengoed and all textiles, Schoenenrek and Kinderkamer opbergers (standalone storage goods), Wasmanden, Droogrekken and Strijkplanken (household), Wandplank and Wandrek (wall shelves - Wall Decor's job), Tuinhuizen & opbergers (sheds), Parasols, Zonwering and Schaduwdoek (shading), Tuinkussen, Tuinmeubelhoes and Tuinmeubel-accessoire (cushions, covers, accessories), Dierenmeubels (pet furniture), Badkamerspiegel and all bathroom fixtures and accessories, and the whole Verlichting, Woonaccessoires, Koken & tafelen and Huishouden departments. DUPLICATE URL: /collections/kinderbed and /collections/kinderbed-1 are the same listing (h1 'Kinderbed', 7 items each); only /collections/kinderbed is recorded.
